# FROZEN — Do Not Edit

This directory is **archived**. Its files are preserved in place because existing explorations under `epics/` reference them directly and must continue to work.

**Do not:**
- Edit any file in this directory
- Add new files here
- Delete this directory

**For new explorations:** Use `shared/elevate-prototyping-kit/` instead.

The `elevate-prototyping-kit` submodule provides the same CSS with improvements and is the active design system for all new work in this workspace.
